title: Using ChatGPT with Unreal5 - Getting started research Notes
author: fisj
selftext:
I'm starting some research into GPT for worldsim and npc behaviours. Wanted to document some of the stuff I'm finding. Unreal is what I use for personal tinkering, so here's what I have so far.

I'm looking to use openAI's API from within unreal. I want to be able to structure prompts programatically, send them through the API, get a response, parse that in unreal and do some actions or change some state based on that.

First step is to get the API working with unreal. Unfortunately there's no great solutions yet that also support the latest chatGPT API.

For now, python is really the only way to go if you want to use the latest chatGPT functionality, but its not very friendly if you're not python literate.

More to come later. Will be looking into langchain and some research papers about associative memory.
